title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Hey, Doctor. Do me a favor and just tell me what you need done.

title: Talk 1
original: I'll be watching you even when I'm off duty.

title: Talk 2
original: Hm? Do you need something?

title: Talk 3
original: My skin is sensitive to sunlight. So please assign me to nighttime missions, whenever you can.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: There's limits to what I'm capable of, but even so, I want to help ease the burden you carry, Doctor.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I can't help but feel just a little envious when I see how the other Operators fight...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I need no particular reason to fight for you, Doctor. I hope to see an exciting frontline battle someday...

title: Idle
original: Doctor, let me be your guardian, now and forever...

title: Onboard
original: Vanguard Yato here. Are you the one I'm protecting?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Thank you.

title: Added to Squad
original: Yato has joined the team.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: We're ready to execute your plans, Doctor.

title: Depart
original: All Operators, be on alert.

title: Begin Operation
original: Targets spotted. Get ready for battle.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Here.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Go ahead.

title: Deployment 1
original: Got it.

title: Deployment 2
original: Understood!

title: In Battle 1
original: In a blink of eye!

title: In Battle 2
original: Prepare yourself!

title: In Battle 3
original: Haaaaghhh!

title: In Battle 4
original: Slash you down!

title: 4-star Result
original: As long as we follow the Doctor's orders, we won't have any problems.

title: 3-star Result
original: The Doctor's brilliant command was the key to victory.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Victory is the most welcome news.

title: Operation Failure
original: I apologize... We failed to execute your plan, Doctor...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Please send me somewhere that sunlight can never touch.

title: Tap
original: *Gasp*!

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, thank you for always taking care of us.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy holidays, Doctor. Thank you for your work over the past year, and may you continue to guide us this year.

title: Greeting
original: Doctor, I will be your shield.

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor. Please, accept this humble gift. Yes, of course I remember your birthday.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: A blade needs a sheath. It is a shelter, and a place to return. For me, Rhodes Island is that sheath.
